profile.locationBio: Centerline Manufacturing began in 2005 as a Houston-based contract manufacturer focused on precision machining for demanding industrial applications. The company provides custom CNC machining and contract manufacturing services, including milling, turning, wire EDM, testing, and inspection, with work centered on close-tolerance metal parts and components. Centerline serves aerospace and defense, energy, medical, high-tech, commercial, and industrial markets, and the company emphasizes domestic production, ITAR registration, and AS9100D and ISO 9001:2015 quality systems. The company operates as a single-source manufacturer for custom-machined products and precision production work across a broad range of applications.

Spring Engineers of Houston is a custom metal products manufacturer focused on springs, wire forms, metal stampings, and spring assemblies. Spring Engineers of Houston began in 1966 and has built its business around engineering support, prototyping, and production runs for industrial, automotive, medical, aerospace, petroleum, and commercial applications. The company provides spring design assistance, corrosion and wear prevention, failure analysis, and in-house testing as part of its manufacturing work. Spring Engineers of Houston serves customers through a broader lineup that includes compression, extension, torsion, coil, garter, wave, and specialty spring products.
